facts.fact: Egypt's FY2026/27 economic and social development plan, reported by Youm7, says the Ministry of Health and Population and partner bodies developed the electronic registration system for births and deaths at national (republic) level.
facts.system: electronic birth and death registration system

facts.fact: Egypt's FY2026/27 development plan, reported by Youm7, says deaths are registered electronically nationwide alongside births, developed by the Ministry of Health and Population and partner bodies.
facts.system: electronic birth and death registration system
